description.narrative: The Health Sector Reform Project for Azerbaijan aims to improve overall health system stewardship and financing, and enhance equitable access to, and technical and perceived quality of essential healthcare services, in the selected districts in a fiscally responsible and sustainable manner with a view to improving health outcomes. The project has the following components: Component A: will assist the Ministry of Health (MOH) to build its capacity in policy making, planning and regulation to design and introduce mechanisms, instruments and tools, training MOH staff and upgrading MOH's technological and physical infrastructure. Component B: will improve the quality, technical, and efficiency of health care services in five pilot districts of Apsheron, Agdash, Ismailli, Sheki and Gakh. Component C: will support health care financing reform in Azerbaijan aiming at gradually introducing universal risk protection against out-of-pocket health expenditures and moving towards insurance principles through improved revenue mobilization, pooling and allocation of health sector resources and purchasing of health care services. Component D: aims to address the long term human resource needs of the health sector. Component D: will ensure effective administration and implementation of the project by supporting the operation of a Project Implementation Unit in the MOH, including coordinating with relevant stakeholders and donors, as well as for procurement, disbursement, financial management, coordination of training events, and for ensuring effective monitoring and evaluation of the outcomes of the project.

The development objective of the proposed project is to improve overall health system stewardship and financing, and enhance equitable access to, and technical and perceived quality of essential healthcare services, in the selected districts in a fiscally responsible and sustainable manner with a view to improving health outcomes.
